'''Ben Kahob''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] who served in the resistance against the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Galactic War|renewed conflict]]. He was murdered by the criminal [[Coronas]] who began to shake down resistance-friendly Corellians.
